regional clusters are not the only important level of external linkages.

A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
clusters are not just a regional phenomenon.
the domestic level is an analytical entity of equal importance to international and regional linkages.

cluster assessment should take into account that firms are embedded in different external linkages, which are likely to influence the assessment.
